svg.title: Terminal: rig up starts the cloud desktop, rig exec runs the tests, rig ls lists the desktops.
svg.desc: rig up creates a box, clones the repo, runs setup and starts the dev server. rig exec -- bun test runs the tests in the box. rig ls shows one running box and one paused box.

text.tspan: Dev server starting: bun run dev (port 3000)
